 Follow Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart To Receive First Joint Award at LA Charity Gala
 Ken Simmons Wed, October 21, 2026 at 6:37 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart To Receive First Joint Award at LA Charity Gala Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart will make a rare public appearance together when they are honored with the Hollywood Icon Award at the Women's Guild Cedars-Sinai Stardust Ball on November 18 at the Beverly Wilshire Hotel. This will be their first joint award. The couple is being recognized for their "extraordinary careers and longstanding commitment to philanthropy."
 The Women's Guild has raised more than $70 million for the Cedars-Sinai Medical Center in Los Angeles.
 Ford has a long history of activism. He is currently vice chair of Conservation International, an American nonprofit environmental organization headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. He has also narrated public service messages promoting environmental involvement for EarthShare, an American federation of environmental and conservation charities.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Star Wars legend is an accomplished pilot, and has led search-and-rescue missions, transported medical professionals and supplies to rescue efforts in Haiti.
 Flockhart, who starred in Ally McBeal from 1997-2002, has dedicated herself to preventing violence against women and children, and animal welfare. She is involved in several humanitarian organizations, including For Goodness Sakes, Peace Over Violence and the Violence Intervention Program.
 Ford and Flockhart married on June 15, 2010 at the Governor's Mansion in Santa Fe, New Mexico. They met in 2002 at the Golden Globes, where he received the Cecil D. DeMille Award for lifetime achievement. Seven years later, Ford proposed on Valentine's Day. They have a son, Liam, whom Flockhart adopted before they met.
 While accepting a Lifetime Achievement Award at the SAG-AFTRA Actor Awards in March, Ford delivered a heartfelt tribute to Flockhart, thanking his "extraordinary, beautiful wife" for giving him the "love and courage to do all of it".
 Advertisement Advertisement Now celebrating his 60th year as a professional actor, Ford remains busy. He currently stars as Dr. Paul Rhodes in the Apple TV series Shrinking . Last year, he appeared on the big screen in Captain America: Brave New World.
